summary: Router 0.32.1 (ADR-0097): the scheduler's interactive fallback takes a cold tier on a node whose warm model is at its limit only if the tier fits beside the models answering there (new Node.answering_vram_gib: measured occupancy of loaded models with a request in flight, same model or blob). Before, the VRAM budget counted the answering model as evictable, so a large cold fallback evicted it once its request ended; the waiting requests then went to the cloud. Read-only arithmetic on existing node state; no route, configuration key, destination, payload or cloud-path change. CI gains one self-test run.

findings.evidence: Fewer cold loads beside a busy model; a voice command that previously took a large cold fallback now waits for the warm model within its existing interactive budget (admission deadline, max_queue unchanged). answering_vram_gib iterates the node's loaded models and inflight counter only.
findings.resolution: Bounded by the existing admission controls; the change reduces model evictions and cloud spill-over under load.

findings.evidence: ci.yml adds `python test/selftest_fallback_keeps_busy_model.py` to the existing test job; no new action, permission, secret or trigger.
findings.resolution: No change to CI trust; the test runs without network, router process or credentials.

tests.evidence: all PASS (8 checks); with scheduler.py from origin/main (0.32.0) the two fallback checks fail (instrument validated).
no FAIL lines; the 0.6.6 interactive fallback to a small tier on another node still passes.

tests.command: ruff check .; python test/check_adr_index.py; python test/selftest_control_flow.py; python test/check_control_flow.py; python test/selftest_english_names.py
tests.evidence: All checks passed; ADR index ok: 97 ADRs; control flow ok: 0 legacy findings.

limitations: Production runs 0.31.1 (0.32.0 was rolled back); this change ships 0.32.0 and 0.32.1 together and is verified after rollout by the staged-question measurement in ADR-0097.
Why the loaded lower tier did not count as a warm candidate at 13:36:49 in the failed measurement was not determined from the available logs.
